G A N E S H S I R I G I D I Full Stack Developer | AI Engineer | Software Engineer

ganeshsirigidi222@gmail.com | +91-8142211529 | Andhra Pradesh, India LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/ganesh-sirigidi-82759215b | GitHub: github.com/GaneshSirigidi

P R O F E S S I O N A L S U M M A R Y

Full Stack Developer and AI Engineer with 3.6 years of experience building scalable web applications and AI-powered

solutions. Skilled in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Generative AI, LLM integration, and conversational AI systems. Proven track record of reducing server latency by 40%, deploying production-grade enterprise AI chatbots, and delivering end-to-end full stack solutions across frontend, backend, and AI domains.

in React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Python, and cloud-native architectures with deep expertise

T E C H N I C A L S K I L L S

Languages

JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, SQL

Frontend

React.js, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Responsive Design

Backend

Node.js, Express.js, Nest.js, Hono.js, FastAPI, REST APIs

Databases

PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Vectorize (Vector DB), Supabase

Cloud & DevOps

AWS, Cloudflare Workers, Railway, Git, GitHub, CI/CD Pipelines

AI & ML

RAG, Generative AI, LLM Integration, Prompt Engineering, Conversational AI (STT, TTS), Agentic AI, LangChain, LangGraph, Agentic AI System Design, Agentic Workflows

Tools

Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Postman, Docker

Messaging & Queue

SQS, SNS, MQTT, RabbitMQ, Qstash

P R O F E S S I O N A L E X P E R I E N C E

SLRI Solutions Pvt Ltd | Full Stack Developer Apr 2026 – July 2026

Built responsive, high-performance user interfaces for an agentic real-time productivity platform featuring collaborative document editor and spreadsheet editor tools, reducing UI interaction latency by 35% through optimized React rendering and state management.

Designed and implemented agentic UI components that expose AI agent actions inline within the editor surface, enabling

users to trigger, monitor, and review agent-driven edits in real time across 5+ distinct agent workflows.

Collaborated directly with AI engineers to define agent-to-UI contracts, translating model outputs and tool-call results into

intuitive, contextually aware editor interactions, cutting integration turnaround time by 40%.

Actanos | Software Engineer Feb 2023 – Mar 2026

Architected and deployed a RAG system using Cloudflare AI Search and vector embeddings, enabling context-aware AI

responses across enterprise knowledge bases, improving retrieval accuracy by 60%.

Designed scalable backend services with Node.js, Python, and PostgreSQL, focusing on clean architecture and

maintainability, supporting 3x traffic growth without infrastructure changes.

Developed responsive frontend components using React.js and Next.js for internal dashboards and client-facing

applications, reducing page load times by 30%.

Reduced server response times by 40% through API optimization, caching strategies, and efficient database query design.

Integrated third-party APIs and internal microservices, improving system interoperability and achieving 99.9% uptime

across production services.

Mentored 10 junior developers through code reviews and technical guidance, improving team code-review turnaround

by 25%.

P R O J E C T S

Admin Rag Platform | TypeScript, Hono.js, Cloudflare AI Search, PostgreSQL, OpenAI, Vectorize

Built a fully managed RAG platform on Cloudflare AI Search enabling clients to deploy custom AI chatbots trained on

proprietary data, reducing deployment time from weeks to under 2 days.

Engineered multi-format document ingestion with automatic chunking, embedding, and vector indexing, achieving over 90%

retrieval precision on client knowledge bases.

Delivered context-aware, domain-specific Q&A; across structured and unstructured enterprise datasets for 10+ enterprise

clients.

PeepulAgri – Precision Farming Platform | TypeScript, Hono.js, PostgreSQL, React.js

Developed full stack precision farming solution with React.js frontend and Node.js backend integrating autonomous robot

telemetry from 50+ field devices.

Implemented computer vision algorithms for plant health analysis using high-resolution field imagery, detecting disease with

85% accuracy.

Engineered variable-rate spraying system reducing chemical usage by 40% through data-driven application logic.

Built IoT-based real-time farm management dashboard delivering analytics and actionable insights to farm operators.

FigLinks – HR Tech SaaS Platform | Hono.js, Next.js, PostgreSQL

Contributed to HR SaaS platform focused on inclusive, objective entry-level interview processes, supporting over 500

concurrent interview sessions.

Resolved critical scalability bottlenecks, improving platform reliability by 45% under high-volume concurrent interview load.

Implemented conversational AI module for real-time HR interview automation, reducing average screening time by 60%.

E D U C A T I O N

Rajiv Gandhi University of Knowledge Technologies | July 2019 – July 2023

Bachelor of Technology – Electronics & Communication Engineering | CGPA: 9.2 / 10.0
